summary: Banco de Chile filed a Form 6-K reporting the local-market placement of senior, dematerialized, bearer bonds, totaling CLF 1,366,000 across two series. Serie FT, registered under number 11/2022, amounted to CLF 466,000 with a maturity of October 1, 2032, and an average placement rate of 2.86%. Serie HC, registration number 20240002, totaled CLF 900,000, maturing August 1, 2034, at an average rate of 2.98%. This is a routine debt issuance by the bank, not a special-situation event. The filing is informational only, submitted to the Chilean regulator and exchanges, with no structural or strategic implications for stakeholders.
